audit: Independent visual QA of four already-generated preparation images
scope: Original rasters and selected source-pack contact sheets plus individual decisive references; producer QA read only after independent initial image/source comparison. No external factual claims or new sources required.
policy: PT2470 allows varma/osin arvio/arvio. Unknown microornament alone is not a rejection. Serious principal-form disagreement is FAIL. PASS/WARN/FAIL are audit findings only, not KK approval.

items.historical_phase: Consistent with selected Hollar later pre-1666 state: classical west portico, square crossing tower without medieval tall spire.
items.main_shape: Long cruciform body, nave/choir roofs, projecting transept, portico and crossing tower agree in broad form with S1-S5. No serious main-cathedral silhouette error identified.

issues.region: Visible south nave clerestory, above aisle roof
issues.finding: Generated upper nave windows are circular oculi; S5 shows small upright round-headed windows. This is a visible source disagreement, not simply an undocumented hidden detail.

issues.region: South nave ancillary range and walled courtyard before transept
issues.finding: Small roofed annex is freely regularized and S1 octagonal chapter-house/cloister relation is not represented reliably; image must not imply accurate complete precinct reconstruction.

varma: Main cathedral mass and selected historical phase
Square tower, west portico, Gothic choir division
arvio: Hidden east end/rose-window treatment and north side
South ancillary precinct, roofing and small ornament

items.framing_3d: Complete isolated church; usable oblique with visible roof and south/west faces. East facade and far side remain hidden; those are explicitly inferred, not validated by this image.
items.review_disposition: May appear in KK comparison as WARN with nave-window and chapter-house/cloister mismatch explicitly beside the image; no owner approval or Tripo readiness inferred.

items.historical_phase: Matches original Hyde Park 1851 phase; no Sydenham multiple transepts, water towers or terraces.
items.main_shape: Very long low rectangular glass hall, stepped tiers and one transverse high barrel-vault centre agree with C2-C4 and subordinate retrospective C1. No serious principal-mass contradiction identified.

issues.region: Roof module pattern, repeated facade bays and centre entrance
issues.finding: The image is a regularized reconstruction: exact bay counts, roof microprofiles, centre entrance details and back elevation are not individually established. Keep these as osin arvio/arvio rather than verified exact geometry.
Whole silhouette is present but right margin is narrow; avoid any automatic additional crop before a future 3D input review.

varma: 1851 Hyde Park major form and singular transept
Long modular iron/glass body and stepped roof masses
osin_arvio: Exact relative dimensions and glazing/bay counts
Central entrance decoration and roof module layout
arvio: Hidden south elevation and service details

items.framing_3d: Whole building isolated in one image; useful long-side/end/roof coverage. Extreme elongated form means small details are tiny; opposite long elevation is hidden.
items.review_disposition: May appear as WARN in KK comparison with regularized bays and unseen south side labeled; no main-shape rejection indicated.

items.historical_phase: Intact main palace, approximately later nineteenth century; no fire ruins, later surrounding shopping arcades or separate garden bandstand fused in.
items.main_shape: Long iron/glass body, central tall drum/dome/statue, central transverse entrance projection, decorated end arches and lower side roofs broadly agree with V2/V3/V4. No serious main-mass contradiction identified.

issues.region: Central lower entrance, subsidiary end arches, roof ornaments and statue
issues.finding: Exact lower entrance structure is partially obscured in photographs; repeated glazing, subsidiary gables, statue identity/detail and ornament have been regularized. Label these as interpretation; principal hall and dome remain source supported.
Statue is fully present but sits close to top edge; preserve full silhouette in any later 3D input framing.

varma: Main palace rather than later arcades
High central drum/dome and statue; longitudinal halls and lower side roofs
arvio: Unseen opposite side and roof junctions
Exact statue, minor ornament and material appearance

items.framing_3d: Whole palace isolated; roof, long facade and end are legible. Top silhouette has narrow margin and far side remains inferred.
items.review_disposition: May appear as WARN in KK comparison; evidence supports principal form while fine geometry remains interpretation.

items.historical_phase: Recognizable circa-1889 principal end, with low pointed roof outline and large fan-shaped glazing; no obvious different-period palace substituted.
items.main_shape: Front gable is recognizable, but generated longitudinal body/side-gallery section materially differs from the supplied structural section. This is larger than uncertain ornament.

issues.region: Near-side long gallery, exposed main sidewall and roof spring/eave relation
issues.finding: M3 shows a two-level side gallery whose roof reaches approximately the main roof spring/eave height, near half the overall arch height. Generated image has a very low single-strip gallery and a large extra exposed tall glazed sidewall above it, with main roof spring/eaves substantially higher. This changes the principal transverse section and longitudinal silhouette. The original M1 photo also shows a substantially taller side-gallery body relative to the main front, though its lower portion is obscured.

issues.region: Hidden rear, long facade bay treatment and roof glazing
issues.finding: Exterior regularization and hidden surfaces remain interpretation. These alone would warrant WARN, but do not account for the major side-gallery/main-roof relationship error.

varma: Long rectangular single great hall; pointed rather than semicircular ridge
arvio: Current generated gallery/body section is materially unreliable
Long-side glazing and exact roof panel layout

items.framing_3d: Complete isolated silhouette with useful oblique roof coverage, but the low side gallery and extra tall main sidewall would be promoted directly into 3D geometry if used uncorrected.
items.review_disposition: Show only as FAIL/diagnostic in KK comparison with M3 directly beside it. Do not promote as an acceptable historic main-shape candidate. No regeneration or correction authorized by this audit.
